model_annotation: Figure 6 illustrates the training rewards over steps for different models on easy and hard training sets. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and is linear, ranging from 0 to 3000 with tick labels every 500 steps. The y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards” and is linear, ranging from 0 to 0.4 with tick labels every 0.1.  There are two lines representing data from the easy training set. A solid blue line, labeled “LLaMa-On-Policy-Easy,” begins at approximately 0.03 and increases to around 0.38 before declining slightly to 0.37 at step 3000. A dashed red line, labeled “LLaMa-LUFFY-Easy,” begins at approximately 0.03 and steadily increases to 0.4 at step 3000.  There are two lines representing data from the hard training set. A solid blue line, labeled “LLaMa-On-Policy-Hard,” begins at approximately 0.005 and exhibits fluctuations, reaching a maximum value of approximately 0.06 at step 1000, then decreasing to around 0.03 at step 3000. A dashed red line, labeled “LLaMa-LUFFY-Hard,” begins at approximately 0.005 and increases to approximately 0.14 at step 1500, then declines to around 0.08 at step 3000.
